# Taha Soumbate, HTML email developer

> Taha Soumbate is a frontend developer based in Morocco. He codes responsive HTML email templates that work in Gmail, Outlook, Apple Mail and on phones, and sells his services on Fiverr (profile: https://www.fiverr.com/tahadigitalab). He speaks English, French and Arabic.

## Services (all ordered through Fiverr)
- HTML email templates, from $20: https://www.fiverr.com/s/jyeWxGv
- Bug fixes and mobile layout repairs, from $10: https://www.fiverr.com/tahadigitalab
- Figma or design to HTML, Tailwind or Bootstrap, from $30: https://www.fiverr.com/tahadigitalab
- Landing pages in HTML + Tailwind or React, from $40: https://www.fiverr.com/tahadigitalab

## Work
- [Portfolio](https://tahasoumbate.github.io/HTML-Email-Templates/): a working inbox with 30 email designs (account, newsletter, payment, e-commerce, notification, survey, report), each built in 5 technologies: hand-coded HTML + CSS, Tailwind, Maizzle, MJML and Bootstrap Email.
- [Source code](https://github.com/TahaSoumbate/HTML-Email-Templates): the compiled emails and their source files.
